components.name: Accordion
components.description: The Accordion component is a flexible UI primitive built with React and TypeScript. It allows users to expand and collapse content sections, making it ideal for FAQs, documentation, and content-heavy interfaces.

props.name: items
props.description: The accordion items to render, in order.

props.name: allowMultiple
props.description: When true, multiple items can stay open at once; when false (default), opening an item closes any other open item.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Indexes of items that start open.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root wrapper element.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the root wrapper element.

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: Classes for each item's outer container.

props.name: itemStyle
props.description: Inline styles for each item's outer container.

props.name: headerClassName
props.description: Classes for each item's clickable header button.

props.name: headerStyle
props.description: Inline styles for each item's clickable header button — applied unconditionally, not only on hover.

props.name: titleClassName
props.description: Classes for the title text span inside the header.

props.name: titleStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the title text span inside the header.

props.name: iconClassName
props.description: Classes for the expand/collapse icon wrapper.

props.name: iconStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the expand/collapse icon wrapper.

props.name: contentWrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the collapsible grid wrapper around the content.

props.name: contentWrapperStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the collapsible grid wrapper around the content.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the inner content container.

props.name: contentStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the inner content container.

props.name: hoverClassName
props.description: Extra classes merged onto the header last, so they can override the built-in hover styling; note they apply at rest too, not only on hover.

props.name: hoverStyle
props.description: Extra inline styles merged onto the header; since inline styles can't express :hover, these apply unconditionally. Prefer hoverClassName.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Declared for future theming but not currently applied anywhere in the render.

props.name: radius
props.description: Declared for future theming but not currently applied anywhere in the render.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Declared for future theming but not currently applied anywhere in the render.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration in milliseconds of the expand/collapse grid-row transition.

props.name: iconOpen
props.description: Custom icon shown when an item is open; defaults to a ChevronUp.

props.name: iconClose
props.description: Custom icon shown when an item is closed; defaults to a ChevronDown.

props.name: renderItem
props.type: (params: { item: AccordionItem; index: number; open: boolean; toggle: () => void; }) => ReactNode
props.description: Fully custom renderer for each item, replacing the default header/content markup. Receives the item, its index, open state, and a toggle callback.

components.name: ActionSheet
components.description: A bottom sheet of contextual actions. It slides up from the bottom edge on phones and becomes a centered card on wider screens, traps focus while open, locks page scroll, respects safe-area insets and reduced motion, and supports destructive and disabled actions.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; omit to let the sheet manage it internally.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the sheet should open or close, controlled or not.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional heading shown above the actions; also the dialog's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting text below the title.

props.name: actions
props.description: Actions listed in the sheet.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Label for the dismiss button.

props.name: hideCancel
props.description: Hides the separate Cancel button.

props.name: closeOnOverlayClick
props.description: Close the sheet when the overlay is clicked.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Close the sheet with the Escape key.

props.name: className
props.description: Styles the bottom panel.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the bottom panel.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Styles the dimmed overlay behind the panel.

props.name: headerClassName
props.description: Styles the title + description block.

props.name: titleClassName
props.description: Styles the title heading.

props.name: descriptionClassName
props.description: Styles the description text.

props.name: actionsClassName
props.description: Styles the list wrapping the action buttons.

props.name: actionClassName
props.description: Applied to every action button.

props.name: cancelClassName
props.description: Styles the Cancel button.

components.name: ActivityHeatmap
components.description: A calendar-aligned contribution grid for commits, deploys, logins or any daily metric. Every column is one week, every row is one weekday, and the intensity ramp is built from your theme tokens.

props.name: data

props.name: weeks
props.description: Number of trailing weeks to display, ending at the latest date; defaults to the full data range.

props.name: endDate
props.description: Last day shown in the grid; defaults to the latest date in `data`.

props.name: colorScale
props.description: Semantic token family used for the intensity ramp.

props.name: size
props.description: Cell size preset.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Shows the "Less / More" legend under the grid.

props.name: showWeekdayLabels
props.description: Shows Mon / Wed / Fri labels beside the grid.

props.name: showMonthLabels
props.description: Shows month labels above the grid.

props.name: formatLabel
props.description: Builds the accessible label and tooltip for each day.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the whole heatmap.

props.name: onDayClick

props.name: className

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the heatmap root.

props.name: gridClassName
props.description: Styles the scrollable grid wrapper (labels + columns).

props.name: cellClassName

props.name: labelClassName

props.name: legendClassName
props.description: Styles the legend row.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.description: A confirmation dialog for decisions that need an explicit answer. It is announced as an alert dialog, focuses Cancel first, blocks Escape and overlay clicks by default, and supports a typed confirmation and async confirm actions with a loading state.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; omit to let the dialog manage it internally.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called whenever the open state changes, controlled or not.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog heading, also used as the accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting copy rendered under the heading.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Label of the primary action button.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Label of the button that dismisses the dialog.

props.name: tone
props.description: Visual treatment of the primary action.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon; defaults to a warning icon for the destructive tone. Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: requireText
props.description: When set, the confirm button stays disabled until this exact text is typed.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when the primary action is confirmed. If it returns a promise, the confirm button shows a spinner and the dialog closes once it resolves (and stays open if it rejects).

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the dialog is dismissed with Cancel, Escape or the overlay.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra body content between the description and the confirmation input.

props.name: closeOnOverlayClick
props.description: Allows closing by clicking the overlay; off by default for forced choices.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Allows closing with Escape; off by default for forced choices.

props.name: className
props.description: Styles the dialog card.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the dialog card.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Styles the dimmed overlay behind the card.

props.name: iconClassName
props.description: Styles the round icon badge.

props.name: titleClassName
props.description: Styles the title heading.

props.name: descriptionClassName
props.description: Styles the description paragraph.

props.name: inputClassName
props.description: Styles the typed-confirmation input.

props.name: footerClassName
props.description: Styles the footer that holds the action buttons.

components.name: AnnouncementBar
components.description: A full-width strip for launches, maintenance windows and billing notices. Four semantic tones, solid or soft styling, an optional action and a dismissal that can be remembered across visits.

props.name: children
props.description: Announcement copy.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color tone of the bar.

props.name: variant

props.name: size
props.description: Height and text size preset.

props.name: dismissible

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Storage key used to remember a dismissal across visits (localStorage).

props.name: action
props.description: Optional trailing action, usually a text link or small button.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the user dismisses the bar.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the landmark region.

props.name: iconClassName
props.description: Styles the leading icon wrapper.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Styles the message text.

props.name: actionClassName
props.description: Styles the action wrapper.

props.name: dismissButtonClassName
props.description: Styles the dismiss button.

components.name: AppShell
components.description: Responsive React app shell with a desktop sidebar, sticky header, mobile navigation drawer, and a main landmark for accessible dashboards. Use contained mode to embed it inside any bounded region.

props.name: sidebar

props.name: header

props.name: children
props.description: Page content rendered inside the main landmark.

props.name: footer
props.description: Optional content pinned below the main region.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Keeps the header visible while the page scrolls.

props.name: mobileSidebarOpen
props.description: Controlled open state of the mobile navigation panel.

props.name: mobileNavLabel

props.name: menuButtonLabel

props.name: sidebarClassName

props.name: mainClassName

props.name: footerClassName

props.name: menuButtonClassName
props.description: Styles the mobile menu button.

props.name: mobileSidebarClassName
props.description: Styles the mobile navigation panel.

components.name: AttachmentCard
components.description: A compact file row for upload queues, message composers and document lists. Shows a type icon or thumbnail, upload progress, ready and error states, and retry or remove actions. It is built from the Neuctra Progress and IconButton components.

props.name: name
props.description: File name displayed as the primary label.

props.name: size
props.description: Human-readable file size, e.g. "2.4 MB".

props.name: progress
props.description: Upload progress from 0 to 100; shown while `status` is "uploading".

props.name: status
props.description: Current attachment state.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Message shown in the error state.

props.name: thumbnail
props.description: Optional thumbnail URL shown instead of the file type icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom leading icon; by default an icon is picked from the file extension.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the file name a link (e.g. to preview or download the file).

props.name: cardSize
props.description: Card density preset.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the retry and remove actions.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when the retry action is pressed in the error state.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Called when the remove action is pressed.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the card root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the card root.

props.name: thumbnailClassName
props.description: Styles the thumbnail or icon tile.

props.name: nameClassName
props.description: Styles the file name.

props.name: metaClassName
props.description: Styles the status / meta line.

props.name: progressClassName
props.description: Styles the progress track.

props.name: actionClassName
props.description: Styles the retry and remove buttons.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: The Avatar component displays profile images, user initials, or fallback icons. Supports multiple sizes, variants, online/offline status, rings, and click interactions.

props.name: src
props.description: Image source URL. When missing, or when it fails to load, the fallback initials (or icon) render instead.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessibility label for the image, and the source used to derive initials when fallback isn't provided.

props.name: size
props.description: Avatar dimensions. "responsive" currently resolves to the same fixed size as "md" internally.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape of the avatar: full circle, rounded corners, or square.

props.name: isOnline
props.description: Shows a status dot using the success color to indicate the user is online.

props.name: isOffline
props.description: Shows a status dot using the muted color to indicate the user is offline.

props.name: ring
props.description: Adds a ring outline around the avatar.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Explicit fallback text (e.g. initials) shown instead of the image; not auto-truncated, unlike the initials derived from alt.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler; when provided, the avatar becomes a focusable, keyboard-activatable button.

props.name: statusPosition
props.description: Corner where the online/offline status dot is placed.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the avatar's root element.

props.name: statusClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the status dot.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the avatar's root element.

props.name: statusStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the status dot.

props.name: imageClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the rendered element.

props.name: fallbackClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the fallback wrapper shown when there is no image.

props.name: iconClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the default user icon shown when there is no image and no initials.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.description: React avatar group with overlapping stack, background rings and an automatic +N overflow counter - built with Tailwind CSS.

props.name: children
props.description: Avatar elements (or any circular content).

props.name: max
props.description: Show at most this many; the rest collapse into a "+N" counter.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the "+N" overflow counter only — it does not resize the avatar children, so match it to their size yourself.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Overlap amount between items.

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: Customize the wrapper span around each visible avatar item.

props.name: counterClassName
props.description: Customize the "+N" overflow counter.

</AvatarGroup>

components.name: Badge
components.description: The Badge component is a versatile UI element for displaying text, counts, notification dots, and icons. Supports multiple sizes, rounded shapes, colors, and click interactions.

props.name: text
props.description: Label text rendered inside the badge.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style: solid fill, outlined border, or soft tinted background.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon rendered alongside the text.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Which side of the text the icon renders on.

props.name: size
props.description: Controls the badge's padding, font size, and icon size.

props.name: rounded
props.description: Fully rounded pill shape when true, rounded-md corners when false.

props.name: notificationDot
props.description: Shows a small dot in the top-right corner; hidden whenever count is set.

props.name: dotColor
props.description: Declared for a custom dot color, but not wired into the render — the dot always uses the destructive color. Use dotStyle or dotClassName instead.

props.name: count
props.description: Displays a numeric or custom count badge in the top-right corner; suppresses notificationDot when set.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Adds an animated ping ring behind the notification dot. Has no effect when count is shown, since the dot itself doesn't render then.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the badge's root element.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles for the badge's root element.

props.name: dotClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the notification dot.

props.name: dotStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the notification dot.

props.name: countClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the count indicator.

props.name: countStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the count indicator.

props.name: iconClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the icon wrapper.

props.name: iconStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the icon wrapper.

props.name: textClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the text label.

props.name: textStyle
props.description: Inline styles for the text label.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler; when provided, the badge becomes a keyboard-focusable button.

components.name: BottomNavigation

props.name: as

components.name: Wizard
components.description: Guide users through multi step flows such as onboarding, imports and checkout. Wizard combines a Stepper with paged content, async validation gates, a loading state on the forward button and focus management between steps.

props.name: steps
props.description: Steps rendered in order.

props.name: activeStep
props.description: Controlled active step index.

props.name: defaultActiveStep
props.description: Initial step index in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Fired whenever the active step changes.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Fired when the final step is completed successfully. May return a promise; the finish button shows a spinner until it settles.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout of the stepper: across the top, or as a sidebar on wide screens.

props.name: size
props.description: Scale of the stepper, padding and footer buttons.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Label for the forward button on non-final steps.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: Label for the backward button.

props.name: finishLabel
props.description: Label for the button on the final step.

props.name: showStepCount
props.description: Shows the "Step 2 of 4" counter in the footer.

props.name: allowStepClick
props.description: Lets users jump back to completed steps by clicking them in the stepper.

props.name: stepperLabelVisibility
props.description: Which labels the horizontal stepper shows. `"auto"` keeps only the markers plus the active step's label on narrow screens. See Stepper's `labelVisibility`.

props.name: stepperClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the stepper wrapper.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the step content area.

props.name: titleClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the step title.

props.name: descriptionClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the step description.

props.name: footerClassName
props.description: Additional classes for the footer bar.
